t:
Section 31310(f) is amended—
    (1) in paragraph (1) by inserting “section 521 or” before “section 5102”; and 
    (2) in paragraph (2) by inserting “section 521 or” before “section 5102”.

fable.w: This section is a purely technical amendment that inserts the cross-reference "section 521 or" into two paragraphs of section 31310(f). It establishes no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, rulemaking authority, or right to sue. The only tempting reading is that the amended provision might involve some process, but nothing in this text itself brings any party outside the federal government into a federal decision.

opus.w: The section only inserts a statutory cross-reference into two paragraphs of an existing law. It creates no comment period, hearing, consultation, advisory body, rulemaking authority or right to sue. No outside party is brought into a federal decision, so there is no participation.
opus.s: in paragraph (1) by inserting “section 521 or” before “section 5102”
opus.b: 1. **Reasoning.** This is a technical amendment. It adds the cross-reference "section 521 or" in two places in 49 U.S.C. 31310(f), which deals with disqualifying commercial drivers who violate out-of-service orders. The amended provision may describe penalties tied to federal enforcement, and that could make it look procedural. But the text adds no hearing, comment period, consultation, advisory body, rulemaking authority or right to sue. No party outside the federal government takes part in any decision.

qwen_chat.w: This section is purely a technical amendment to statutory citations. It does not establish any process, committee, hearing, or consultation mechanism itself. It merely updates where other provisions are referenced. Therefore, it does not involve participation.

Resolution: This section is purely a technical amendment to statutory citations. It does not establish any process, committee, hearing, or consultation mechanism itself. It merely updates where other provisions are referenced. Therefore, it does not involve participation.
